match.userMessage: One greyscale storyboard frame. Frozen in this action: Scarlett hooks the tote strap with her elbow and checks the lipstick bullet in the parked car window. Framing: medium close-up, eye level, Scarlett's moving hands and face share the frame, with the parked car window catching the lipstick reflection and the city softly blurred behind her. Placement only, not the pose: Scarlett walks at the curb with her tote strap loose, one hand near the bag and her face turned slightly toward the street. Camera, as one or two arrows: pan, smooth. Characters: Scarlett, Female, 20s, A sharp-eyed young woman of medium height, A sleek black turtleneck with a streamlined black-and-neutral. The bodies are frozen in that action: if someone sits, they are seated; if someone reaches, the arm is extended. One figure per character. Drawn as a storyboard artist's animatic frame: confident pencil line with flat grey marker tones, three or four values, greyscale only even where the description names a colour. Clear silhouettes, the set blocked in with simple shapes. Camera travel is one or two arrows. A rough pre-production drawing: not a finished illustration, not a photo, not a 3D render. The drawing fills the whole image edge to edge: no border, no frame line, no paper margin, no grid of panels. No text, no titles, no subtitles, no watermarks, no letters, no words, no signs, no UI elements.
